FAQ

Questions, answered

Can’t find what you need? Our front desk replies on WhatsApp within 10 minutes, 9 AM–11 PM.

All FAQsContact support
How do I book a slot?

Choose your pitch, date and time on the booking page, add any rentals, and pay the advance or full amount with bKash, Nagad, Rocket, card or bank. You get an instant SMS and email confirmation with a QR code.

Do I need to pay the full amount online?

No. You can pay a 30% advance online and settle the balance at the front desk in cash or mobile banking. Some peak and tournament slots require full payment.

What is your cancellation policy?

Cancel 24+ hours before start for a 100% refund of your advance, 12–24 hours for 50%, and under 12 hours the advance is forfeited. Refunds to wallet earn a 20% bonus. The exact policy version you accepted is shown on your booking.

Can we book half of the pitch?

Yes. Pitch A can be booked as a full 7-a-side pitch or as two independent 5-a-side halves. When someone books the full pitch both halves are blocked automatically, and vice-versa.

What happens if it rains?

Indoor Pitch B is unaffected. For outdoor pitches our staff can issue a rain cancellation: you choose a free reschedule, a full refund, or wallet credit with a bonus.
